account.timing: For month t use data through t-lag. Primary lag2 leaves one whole month gap. Lag1 is idealized latest-month sensitivity. Costed rebalance before earning montht index/RF return; no real fill-price proof. Feature rows carry synthetic as_of=information month-end; not original publication time.
account.risk_free_cash: Residual cash earns realized current-month RF exceptCZERO. No forward RF enters allocation signals. Cash transactions have no fees.
account.rebalance: Monthly all candidates and CEQ49; CMKT buy-and-hold after initial98% allocation; CRF andCZERO holdcash. Fees charged on absolute risky dollars changed; NAV_after+rate*turnover=NAV_before. Terminal risky liquidation charged at finalmonthend.
account.drawdown: Opening pre/post-cost and month-end/terminal marks only; intra-month/intraday loss unknown.

selection.before_evaluation: Compute alltrainingcases first. Atprimarycost/lag choose up to5candidates each: stable(positiveCAGR,smallerDDthanCMKT; rankleastDDthenhigherCAGRthenID),growth10(CAGR>=.10; rankCAGRthenID),growth25(CAGR>=.25; same). Savechoices before evaluation/full. Emptygroupsstayempty.
selection.robust_candidate_screen: PositiveCAGR in full andevaluation for ALL6cost/lagcases. Stable additionallyhas strictlysmaller absoluteDDthan matchedCMKT inall12comparisons. >=10and>=25 thresholdcounts shown forprimaryfullANDprimaryevaluation; scenario sensitivity separate. All are retrospective candidates, no broker qualification.

regimes.causal_labels: At t-lag classify trailing12market excess compoundreturn positive/negative, and trailing12market samplevol above/below expandingmedian of trailing12vol availablethroughcutoff (starting1969-07). Fourstates, no tuning.
regimes.interpretation: Posthoc performance slices and exposure/contribution explanation are associations/mechanics, not proofnews causedreturns or a forecast.

multiple_testing.evaluation: 200candidate primarycost/lag monthlynetreturns minusmatchedCMKT; centered stationary-block bootstrap, mean block6months,2000replicates,seed20261020; sharedindices acrosscandidates; compare observedmean to bootstrapmaximum acrossall200; adjustedp=(1+exceedances)/2001. Resamplingdiagnostic notfutureprofitprobability, doesnotaccountallpriorprojecttrials ormodelmisspecification.

immutability: No ruleorparameterchanges after newperformance; softwarebugfixes requireerrata preservingfailedruns. No leverageincrease or hindsightstockselection to fillquotas.
